text:
jordan: Heads up — customer reported retries getting billed twice. Trace looks like quota consumed before dedupe check.

maria: Oof. Do they send new Idempotency-Key each retry?

jordan: Yes, client SDK currently generates a fresh Idempotency-Key per attempt. Our auth layer charges tokens immediately, so retries => double charge.

sam: We pre-charge to prevent thundering herd token storms, but clearly this interacts badly with idempotency that only settles later.

lee: Two approaches: 1) run dedupe fingerprint lookup first and short-circuit (no charge), or 2) keep pre-charge but add robust refund flow when dedupe wins. Thoughts?

tia: Refunds are painful for audit + accounting. I'd prefer a reservation model: reserve quota up-front with TTL, commit on success, auto-expire on no-commit.

maria: Reservation feels clean. API could return X-Quota-Reservation and a TTL. Backend holds reservation; billing only converts reservation->charge on commit. We'll need clear semantics for partial responses and streaming.

jordan: Example header sketch:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <key>
Idempotency-Key: abc123
X-Reserve-Quota: true
Body: { prompt: "..." }

200 -> { reservation_id: "r_01F...", expires_in: 30 }
```

quota-bot: detected 47 duplicate-charge incidents across 6 orgs in last 24h (auto-summary) :warning:

sam: We need to be careful about ordering: dedupe lookup must be strongly consistent with reservation creation, otherwise two concurrent attempts may both reserve. Suggest flow: dedupe lookup -> if miss, create reservation with dedupe lock -> process -> on success write dedupe record and commit reservation.

lee: Good. Also think about client crash after reserve and never commit: reservation TTL handles reclamation. For long-running jobs we can provide heartbeat/extend endpoints.

tia: Telemetry: emit counters quota.reserved, quota.committed, quota.expired, quota.refunded, dedupe.hit, dedupe.miss. Tag traces with idempotency_key and reservation_id. Add alert if refunds/expired > 1% for an org.

maria: Console UX: show pending reservations per org, a small panel with reservation churn, and a rollout toggle (enable reservation mode for X% of traffic). Also surface example failing requests in the quota dashboard.

sam: Billing changes: support tentative reservations in invoice line items (uncommitted -> archived after TTL). We'll need accounting mapping but doable. I'll pair with finance.

jordan: I'll open the runtime PR to implement dedupe-first flow + reservation API. @oncall can you watch for new incidents while we do the rollout?

oncall: yup, will monitor and escalate if duplicates spike.

maria: I'll add e2e tests that simulate flaky clients generating new Idempotency-Key per retry and assert single-billing behavior.

jordan: Thanks all — plan: implement reservation PoC behind feature flag, wire telemetry and console panels, run 10% rollout, monitor refunds/expired metrics, then flip globally.
